snippet.title: Reaper - Tale of a Pale Swordsman
snippet.description:
Out now on Google Play Store -
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.hexage.reaper

iOS App Store -
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/reaper-tale-pale-swordsman/id698299228?mt=8

Mac App Store -
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/reaper/id698147017?mt=12

Windows Store -
http://apps.microsoft.com/windows/app/reaper/348bb95e-5acc-422f-a448-93716f00f9c1

Windows Phone Store -
http://www.windowsphone.com/en-us/store/app/reaper/379ec2dc-bc90-414b-ad40-ba1069600020

BlackBerry App World -
http://appworld.blackberry.com/webstore/content/36259893/

Amazon Appstore -
http://www.amazon.com/gp/mas/dl/android?p=net.hexage.reaper


Become the Black Swordsman!
Enter the world ripe with riches, magic and monsters. Slay thousands of enemies in an epic action RPG!

http://www.hexage.net/reaper/
